formal.method: Exact three-edge temporal cone expansion and unrestricted combinational SAT
formal.scope: All IEEE input bit patterns and MAC/EXP2 selections, at every output after three rising clocks; unmasked gate != delayed legacy oracle proven zero. No reciprocal or scheduling claim.
formal.completeness: The exact time-3 output cone has no initial-register leaves. Arbitrary start states therefore give the same zero-mismatch identity for every later three-clock window.

unroll_audit.clock_check: All original DFF/SDFF CLK pins exactly match top clock, positive edge
unroll_audit.scope: Exact target outputs after the specified rising clocks from arbitrary state. Empty initial-state cone establishes the identity for every later window.
